statement.math: Subset closure (downward): AdmissibleZ is closed under passing to subsets. For K ⊆ H, AdmissibleZ H gives AdmissibleZ K, with the same omitted residue class for each prime.
statement.lean: theorem admissibleZ_subset {H K : Finset ℤ} (hKH : K ⊆ H) (hH : BGP212.Gap.AdmissibleZ H) : BGP212.Gap.AdmissibleZ K
statement.proof_term: by intro p hp; obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hH p hp; exact ⟨r, fun h hh => hr h (hKH hh)⟩

hypotheses.statement: K ⊆ H, taken as the theorem's argument hKH
